best_direction.angle_title: When being right in the argument became the problem
best_direction.core_claim: Most debate essays prove argument skill. This one should show the moment skill became the problem — and what the student did once they stopped leading with it.
best_direction.why_this_is_the_real_story: The conflict itself is not the interesting part. The essay is about the moment feedback changed how the student was operating in the room.
best_direction.what_it_reveals_about_the_student: It shows that the student can absorb feedback in the middle of a conflict and change how they are handling it — without shutting down or digging in.
best_direction.why_it_beats_the_obvious_angle: An essay about argument skill stays at the surface. This version goes to the correction — a less obvious and more interesting story.
best_direction.main_risk_if_written_poorly: If written too generally, this collapses into a teamwork essay instead of a scene-driven story about changed behavior.
best_direction.next_move: Start with the moment feedback landed. Then write the next interaction where your behavior is visibly different. Cut everything that does not show the shift. Keep returning to the shift from being right to being constructive in conflict.

alternatives.what_this_angle_would_focus_on: Execution quality and accomplishment evidence in the same experience.
alternatives.why_it_is_weaker: It can show capability, but it underweights internal change and essay-level tension.
alternatives.failure_mode: Can collapse into an activity summary without a deeper interpretive claim.

alternatives.what_this_angle_would_focus_on: How your actions affected other people and community outcomes.
alternatives.why_it_is_weaker: It carries moral seriousness, but the self-revision arc is less sharply evidenced than the winner.
alternatives.failure_mode: Can become broad values prose if the turning moment is not dramatized.

depth_signals.detected_tension: The tension is between what happened and what it actually changed in you.
depth_signals.obvious_but_weaker_angle: Obvious but weaker angle: leadership/communication traits without a real revision moment.
depth_signals.essay_opportunity: Frame the essay around the shift from being right to being constructive in conflict.
